questions.q: The average age of a teacher and three students (all the same age) is 20. The teacher is 20 years older than each student. What is the teacher's age?
questions.why: T + 3S = 80 and T = S + 20, so S = 15 and T = 35. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2024.

questions.q: Find the compound interest on ₹1,600 at 10% a year for 2 years, compounded annually.
In a certain code PEN is written as QGQ. How is INK written in that code?
questions.why: The letters move forward by 1, 2 and 3 places: I-J, N-P, K-N.

questions.q: In a group of 110 people, 57 like Hindi, 72 like English and 24 like neither. How many like only Hindi?
questions.why: Both = 57 + 72 − (110 − 24) = 43; only Hindi = 57 − 43 = 14. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a code language, 'this is not me' = 'ar rt st pt'; 'not you but him' = 'mn we rt qs'; 'me and you come' = 'yu mn pt xr'; 'but this is him' = 'ar we st qs'. What is the code for 'me'?
questions.why: 'me' is common to sentences 1 and 3; the common code is pt. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.

questions.q: Statement: “Management should implement remote work to improve productivity.” Which assumption is implicit?
questions.why: The advice only makes sense if remote work does raise productivity. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2026.

questions.q: The present ages of Neha and Kiran are in the ratio 2 : 6. After 4 years the ratio will be 5 : 11. What is Kiran's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 2k and 6k: (2k + 4)/(6k + 4) = 5/11 gives k = 3, so Kiran is 18. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statement: Sales of a product have fallen sharply. Courses of action: I. Study rival products in the market. II. Cut the price and improve quality.
questions.why: Study comes first; II prescribes a remedy before the cause is known. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 11:30?
Find the wrong number in the series: 29, 33, 37, 41, 45, 54, 53
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 4, so 54 should be 49. GPSC-style practice item.
